(() => {
  'use strict';
  const fragment = `#version 300 es
precision highp float;
precision highp int;
precision highp sampler2D;
in vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D image;
layout(location=0) out vec4 outColor;
void main() {
  outColor = texture(image, v_uv);
}`;

  const descriptor = {
    moduleApiVersion: 1,
    executionApiVersion: 1,
    id: 'sosboy-san.copy-filter',
    name: 'Copy Filter',
    version: '1.0.1',
    implementationRevision: 'copy-1.0.1',
    kind: 'filter',
    supportedStages: ['pre', 'post'],
    parameters: [],
    author: 'sosboy-san',
    license: 'MIT',
    readme: '前・後フィルターの接続確認用です。GPUコピーのみで、画像加工やパラメータはありません。1.0.0と1.0.1は同じ画質です。別版追加と更新の確認に使用してください。',
    description: '画像を変更せずGPUでコピーする検証用フィルター。',
    create(host) {
      let program = null;
      let disposed = false;
      return {
        prepare() {
          if (disposed) throw Error('Disposed');
          program = host.createProgram({ fragment, samplers: ['image'] });
          return { supported: true };
        },
        execute({ input, output }) {
          if (disposed || !program) throw Error('Not prepared');
          host.drawPass({ program, inputs: { image: input }, output });
          return { kind: 'written' };
        },
        dispose() {
          if (disposed) return;
          disposed = true;
          if (program) host.releaseProgram(program);
          program = null;
        },
      };
    },
  };
  (globalThis.__KKGR_MODULES__ ??= []).push(descriptor);
})();
